name: Qwen
description: Qwen is Alibaba Cloud’s model team. Alibaba’s principal executive offices are in Hangzhou, China. Its mission is to create large language and multimodal models that support multilingual, flexible tasks and broaden access to foundational AI capabilities.

sources.notes: Qwen's official about page identifies the Qwen Team and links to Alibaba Cloud and ALiYun.
Alibaba Cloud's official press release describes Qwen as a family of models developed by Alibaba and its proprietary Qwen models.
Alibaba's official FAQ lists its principal executive offices in Hangzhou, China; this is recorded as the parent-company location.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified for Alibaba Cloud's Qwen affiliation and parent-company location; Qwen is not treated as a separate legal headquarters.
